obligations.expected_behavior: When the binding trace is missing or deleted, reject the affected evidence as invalid.
forbidden_result: Evidence is accepted or treated as valid despite the missing binding trace.
obligations.observable_result: The isolated binding-deletion case produces an evidence-invalid result.
obligations.state_after: The evidence is classified as evidence-invalid.
obligations.state_before: Evidence exists with its required binding trace removed or missing.
obligations.subject: NFR-2 evidence auditability
obligations.trigger: A binding trace is missing or deleted from the evidence.

obligations.expected_behavior: Verify the missing-trace rejection using an isolated binding-deletion fixture while holding all other inputs constant.
forbidden_result: The witness changes other inputs while testing the binding deletion.
obligations.observable_result: An independent witness records the evidence-invalid outcome for the isolated binding-deletion fixture.
obligations.state_after: The auditability result has an independent witness tied to the isolated fixture and unchanged control inputs.
obligations.state_before: The NFR-2 auditability check is configured with a binding-deletion fixture and controlled, otherwise unchanged inputs.
obligations.subject: NFR-2 auditability verification
obligations.trigger: Verification of the NFR-2 missing-trace condition is performed.
